scope: GMA-C8 r2 exact-capacity numerics-only campaign result. C8 is exactly eight merged K/V representatives and never an 8+1 route. One fixed merge source is retained over one selector, probe and route.

requires.why: merge.run must be called with this measured tile span. The retained c8 wrapper uses 21, which is output-identical but slower. NativeC8R2 fixes the value at 105 so it cannot silently drift.

original_sources.gma_c8_r2.py: written for this package (numerics-only wrapper; fixes tiles at 105)

packaging_changes: gma_c8_r2.py fixes the merge tile span at 105, loads only gma_c8_d10a_fused_argmax_v0.cu, and has no tier or overlap switches. Buffer shapes, dtypes, call order and input validation are unchanged.
Extension module names carry a _c8r2_20260912 suffix so this package and kernels/best/c8 cannot alias different sources onto one cached extension name.
The retained CUDA source is byte-identical to the screened campaign source; no kernel source was edited during packaging.
The public and runtime bitwise, numerics_v18 and overlap alternatives were removed. Their measurements remain in evidence.json and their deleted source files remain recoverable from git history.

retained_implementation.name: numerics
retained_implementation.note: The algorithm is unchanged: same selector, C=8 hard clustering, C32/CG45 geometry and routing. The selected sparsity pattern is unchanged because seeds are bitwise identical. Merge arithmetic differs at the 1e-4 level; about 5.5 per million key-ownership near-ties resolve to the other seed. Three independent 20-video same-node paired screens passed. See evidence.json.
